name: B10-0527/2025 (ESN) – Post-election killings and the deteriorating human rights situation in Tanzania, including the case of imprisoned opposition leader Tundu Lissu
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the post-election killings and deteriorating human rights situation in Tanzania, including the case of imprisoned opposition leader Tundu Lissu
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly condemns Tanzania's violent crackdown on protesters after the October 2025 election, in which hundreds were reportedly killed. It asks Tanzania to bring those responsible for killings and disappearances to justice, and to release jailed opposition leader Tundu Lissu. It calls on the ruling party to hold talks with all opposition parties on constitutional, judicial and electoral reform. It also says European Union money for governance in Tanzania has not worked and should be reconsidered. The text is a statement of position and requests; it does not itself change any law.

- The European Union has frozen some funds to Tanzania; the Parliament asks the Commission to rethink its whole approach.
- Tanzania's government and ruling party are urged to prosecute killers and free opposition leader Tundu Lissu.
- The Parliament asks for talks between the ruling party and all opposition parties on reform; the resolution is sent to Tanzanian and European Union bodies.
